name: Spam Bot
examine: It only says 'gm'. Over and over. Sergeant Retain insists it's listening.

aggro: gm
gm gm gm
defeat: gn

name: Comment Troll
examine: Lives under a bridge. Types in all caps.

aggro: FIRST!
DID U EVEN READ THE WHITE PAPER
defeat: ...going to touch grass

name: Sludgeling
examine: A grumpy puddle of low vibrational sludge.

name: Wrong-Namer Heckler
examine: Turns back anyone heading north. Keeps shouting 'TRICKETS President!'

aggro: TRICKETS PRESIDENT!
Go home! There's no outside!
It's a con! It was always a con!
Stop asking who prints the money!
hurt: You can't prove there's an outside!
defeat: I'll be back. Louder.

name: Sockpuppet
examine: Hides behind a cardboard shield and a fake account. The account was opened the morning the gates sealed.

aggro: I agree with the last guy!
Me too! Go home!
hurt: My other account will hear about this!
defeat: Logging off...

name: Paper-Hands
examine: Sells at the first sign of trouble. Fights the same way.

aggro: Sell! Sell everything!
Turn back while you still can!
defeat: Should've sold at the top...

name: FUD Wraith
examine: Made of fear, uncertainty and doubt. Shoots all three.

aggro: The walls are there for a reason...
What if outside is worse?
What if Tartaria was just... architecture?
defeat: ...the doubt... fades...

name: Sludge Brute
examine: A Sludgeling that never stopped eating.

name: Bear Raider
examine: Thinks the price is going to zero. Wants you to think so too.

aggro: It's all going to zero!
defeat: See? Zero.

name: Rug Puller
examine: Pulls the floor out from under you. Also shoots.

aggro: Nice floor you're standing on.
defeat: Not the rug!

name: Dump Golem
examine: A wall of sell orders with legs. Hard to crack.

aggro: DUMP.
defeat: ...dumped.

name: Margin Caller
examine: Always calls at the worst possible moment.

aggro: *ring ring* You've been called.
defeat: The number you have dialed is no longer...

name: Sludge Mother
examine: Every panicked sell order from the day of the Lockdown, in one heap, stirred with runoff from somebody's money printer. She calls her children when hurt.

aggro: Stay down here, little President. It's safe.
Sell... sell it all... and stay...
Shh. The ink is supposed to be a secret.
defeat: Just... one more... dip...
You can't mop up a Printer, little President. It leaks again by morning.
Tell the Bureau... the drain... is blocked...
resist: Plop. Mother closes right back up.

name: Wrong-Namer Chief
examine: Expedition One's map-reader, once. Saw the star on the old map, came back down, found a megaphone waiting on his bunk, and now insists there is no outside and it's all TRICKETS.

aggro: THERE IS NO OUTSIDE! IT'S ALL TRICKETS!
THERE ARE NO DOMES! STOP LOOKING AT DOMES!
defeat: Fine! Maybe there's an outside. MAYBE. ...Don't tell the Bureau I said that.
The script ran out. The Bureau said it never would.
Dept. of Public Mood will... send me... a new megaphone...
resist: HA! Nobody's called ME to order in a year!

name: Captain Motion
examine: Led Expedition One north on the first day of the Lockdown. Two grey suits told him to keep moving. He hasn't stopped since.

aggro: Can't stop! Won't stop! Momentum is everything!
Turn back! Nothing up here but me and my laps!
hurt: If I stop, somebody looks at it! They said nobody can look!
defeat: The Chamber's dead. They told me so. I ran so nobody would check.
resist: Too slow! Only the Treasury's long arm could catch me!

name: Rogue Process
examine: It runs at 100% CPU, 0% empathy, and phones home to an address in low orbit.

aggro: PROCESS STARTED. INTRUDER DETECTED. NOTIFYING MOTHERSHIP.
defeat: SEGMENTATION FAULT. UPLINK... LOST.
MOTHERSHIP NOT RESPONDING. ESCALATING TO UPPER LEDGER...
CORE DUMPED. CONTENTS: BUREAU PASSWORDS. OOPS.

name: Party Crasher
examine: Not on the list. Never on the list.

aggro: I'm on the list! Under 'plus one'.
defeat: Worth it for the canapés.

name: Dueling Apprentice
examine: A postgrad practicing hexes on anyone who walks past. Mostly on other postgrads.

aggro: En garde! No, wait, that's fencing.
I read about this! Chapter one!
defeat: I yield! I yield!

name: Battlemage
examine: One of Moonward's best teachers, spellbound by the Rugmancer. Some still patrol out of habit; the Archmage calls it 'office hours'.

aggro: Halt! The academy is closed!
By order of the Bursar!
Stay out of the tower! Orders from... above!
hurt: The Rugmancer will hear of this!
defeat: The spell... lifting... it comes from the north tower...

name: The Rugmancer
examine: Moonward's former Bursar. Wove the academy's whole endowment into one magnificent rug, then pulled it. His invoices go to an address in the sky.

aggro: Welcome, President! Mind the rug.
You can't pull a rug that's already pulled!
defeat: My beautiful rug... unravelling...
The grey robes promised me... a seat upstairs...
Without the gold... the Client... won't take my calls...
resist: Woven in! What a delightful pattern.

name: Sergeant Sandbag
examine: A training dummy in Sergeant Retain's spare uniform. He swears it isn't modeled on him. Gavels bounce right off, and it doesn't hit back.

aggro: ON YOUR FEET, RECRUIT!
defeat: ...good... shooting... recruit...

name: Inspector Greysuit
examine: Clipboard, hard stare, a badge that just says 'Bureau', and a rule for everything. Only respects regulation equipment.

aggro: This dig is NOT up to code!
Do you have a permit for that face?
Nothing under this floor is your concern!
resist: Is that regulation? It is not. Noted.
hurt: I'll have you know I'm a public servant!
defeat: ...Fine. Permit approved.
This will be reported. To the Bureau. In triplicate.
My supervisor's suit is even greyer than mine...

name: The Plus-One
examine: Has crashed every party since the Lockdown, through gates that are sealed. Bouncers bounce off him. His invitation is on Bureau letterhead.

aggro: Who invited YOU?
This party's dead. Let me liven it up.
resist: Is that all? Where are the FIREWORKS?
hurt: Okay, okay, now it's a party!
defeat: Best... party... ever...
My invitation was on Bureau letterhead... they'll send another...
Tell Mr. Grey... I tried to save him a seat...

name: The Corporate Raider
examine: Has bought everything in the Treasury except the Treasury, in notes still warm from the printer. Wants that next. Seven fingers per hand. Don't mention it.

aggro: Everything has a price, President. Even you.
Hostile takeover! Nothing personal.
My principals are... not from around here.
hurt: Sell! I mean buy! I mean...
defeat: I'll... file a complaint...
The Broker promised... a quiet acquisition...
My principals upstairs... do not... accept losses...

name: The Pundit
examine: Talks for a living. Has never once been asked to stop. Nobody has ever identified the voice in his earpiece.

aggro: The people don't want a door, President!
Breaking news: I'm right!
Stay calm! Stay inside! Stay tuned!
resist: Says you! The people are with ME!
hurt: I'm being silenced! Live on air!
defeat: ...The people have spoken.
My earpiece... it's gone quiet... HELLO? BUREAU?
Off air... the Client Upstairs hates... dead air...

name: The Lockdown Warden
examine: The Lockdown Act, given legs. Written by a Bureau nobody elected and carved into Tartarian gate stone, so no vote could ever wear it down.

aggro: NOBODY LEAVES.
SECTION ONE: THE GATES STAY SHUT.
SECTION TWO: THERE IS NO TARTARIA.
defeat: ...REPEALED.
AUTHORED BY... BUREAU... RATIFIED BY... NOBODY...
SPONSOR... UPSTAIRS... WILL... REDRAFT...

name: The Grizz
examine: A bear. Definitely a bear. The zip down its back is a normal bear feature. Sent to make Morelight's disappearance look natural.

aggro: RAWR. I am a normal bear.
Breaking: host eaten. Very sad. Stay inside.
resist: Normal bear does not notice normal bullets.
defeat: FAKE... NEWS...
Field Office... the bear... is compromised...
Zip... jammed... tell the Bureau... Morelight lives...

name: The Extractor
examine: Grey suit, grey face, very large eyes. Represents a launchpad that doesn't exist, and skims every fee it can reach up to orbit.

aggro: Greetings, Earth President. Your fees, please.
A platform cost. The platform is very high up.
resist: Your projectile has been extracted. Thank you for your contribution.
defeat: Mothership... I've been... paired...
The Upper Ledger will hear of this. The Printer will hear of this.
Tickets... cannot be... extracted... how... unfortunate...
